segments.text: Retrieves the current effective patches (the patch and the approval state) for the specified patch baseline. Applies to patch baselines for Windows only.

The [[p0]] structure defines metadata about a patch along with the approval state of the patch in a particular patch baseline. The approval state includes information about whether the patch is currently approved, due to be approved by a rule, explicitly approved, or explicitly rejected and the date the patch was or will be approved.
Provides metadata for a patch, including information such as the KB ID, severity, classification and a URL for where more information can be obtained about the patch.
